message: Hi, I am new to this collect calls from jail thing. I have been looking for my father for a long time (never met him) now and recently found him in Arizona State Prison. We have been writing to communicate for the last couple of weeks because all I have is a cell phone (it is most affordable because of my job and no money for home phone service) I live in FL so I can not go visit him (have no money) but I want to beable to talk to him just to hear his voice. He has been in their since 2001 and he is not suppose to get out untill mid 2010 so I was thinking about getting a LANLine and have been looking around for a decent one that doesn't cost that much and that you can exept collect calls on and ran across this site first. Can anyone give me any info. on how I can find out if Arizona to deal with T-Netix/Evercom or Correctional Billing Services. I really want to talk to him we have alot to discuss but I don't want to go through what you guys have " I rather write a letter " And if anyone should be locked up it should be the people that run these phone companies that rip off us hard working individuals that are just trying to make it in life and keep in touch with our families. I wish they had to go through everything you all have went through and for some still are going through. I bet they couldn't even put up with half the sh*t you all have. Don't they understand if they put blockes on our phones and make it to where we can't speak to our loved ones they will go crazy in their they don't know whats going on they don't know why the block is their they just know their is one. I know when I was in jail everyone I knew had a block and I got so depressed. They can get depressed to and get mad and that can just lead up to more charges or on lock down in a one person cell with nobody to talk to at all. From reading all the post from you all it seems like thats what they want. THEY SHOULD BE LOCKED UP FOR ROBERY!!!! I mean not only for the money they stole but for the time they stole away from you talking to your loved ones. I got to go after reading all these post it just makes me sick to see how some people make a living off of other peoples heartache. I wish you all well. And can some reply to my post I would really like to know if I can make it around these a**holes
